topic: Number of EAR violations Cadence admitted in its BIS civil settlement (July 2025)
disagreement: BIS's press release cites 56 violations for CSCC/NUDT sales plus two further violations from the Phytium contract transfer (58 named); DLA Piper's summary of the settlement says 61 violations.
possible_reasons: population: BIS text also mentions 'other Entity List parties', which may add violations not itemised in the press release
definition: press release vs settlement agreement may count charges differently
rationale: BIS is the tier-1 regulator source; DLA Piper is a tier-2 summary. However the BIS figure covers only the CSCC portion explicitly.
remaining_uncertainty: The BIS final order / proposed charging letter PDF was not opened; it would give the definitive count.

topic: How many EDA partners are in TSMC's OIP EDA Alliance
disagreement: TSMC's 2021 blog and 2024 annual report both say 16 EDA partners; TSMC's EDA Alliance web page lists 11 partners as of 23 September 2026.
possible_reasons: period: 2021/2024 counts vs a 2026 list; partners may have left or been acquired (e.g. Ansys into Synopsys in 2025)
definition: annual-report count may include partners not shown on the public list
rationale: Different dates; the 2026 list is the most current but the two figures do not measure the same point in time.
remaining_uncertainty: Which five partners dropped off, and whether TSMC's 2025 annual report gives a new count, was not checked.
